3A  Pronunciation
Description Students group words by sound
Lesson link Use this activity after exercise 3a or 3b, page 24
Time
10 minutes
Extra material Print out, photocopy, and cut in half the Pronunciation worksheet – one for each pair of students
Instructions
a Tell SS they are going to do some pronunciation
revision from File 2. Make sure all books are
closed.
b Divide SS into pairs and give each pair a copy of
the worksheet. Explain that they need to put each
word into a group according to how the part in
bold sounds. Do the first one with SS: tall goes in
/O;/.
c Point out to SS that the easiest way to do this
activity is to say each word out loud.
d When SS have finished, elicit answers from the
class.
Answers
/z/ zero  is  bags
/s/ house  books  son
/&/ black  family  laptop
/eI/ day  same  name
/A;/ fast  father  card
/O;/ tall  board  door
